title: Wardenby关联交易认证修订
instruction:
你是Lanternwood Supply的高级监管会计师，负责支持Wardenby Utilities的年度关联方交易合规申报。财务总监Ragnhild Hendricks须于下周五签署该申报；监管委员会审计员Mateo Marchetti可能据此决定是否启动专项审计。请根据Ragnhild对草稿的审阅意见修订认证附表：她认为草稿像教程，混淆了管理层声明与会计结论，没有解释同比变动，还暗示了我们并未实施的审计鉴证。附表既要让不熟悉关联方会计的高管签署人能够理解，也要足够精炼，便于专业复核人员审阅。覆盖截至2025年12月31日的年度，并与2024年比较。两个年度记录的关联方交易金额分别为$25.0 million和$23.1 million：客户运营为$7.4 million和$7.0 million，共享IT为$5.8 million和$5.3 million，车队为$4.2 million和$4.1 million，工程为$7.6 million和$6.7 million。工程金额的增长反映了其高峰需求分摊模型；该模型负责人声明模型得到了前后一致的应用，但会计部门并未验证模型设计或其运营输入。
即使 Wardenby 手册禁止抵消，日志也将陈旧附属应收账款与应付账款进行净值比较：2025 包含 $0.78 百万应收账款和 $0.47 百万应付账款，显示为 $0.31 百万净余额，而$0.18 百万应收账款和 $0.085 百万应付账款，显示为$0.095百万净值，单位为2024。上个周期的审计发现季度调节较晚且审核证据缺失。 2025 调节已按时完成，但舰队第二季度审查未注明日期。委员会表格要求有一个签字位置，而未解决的问题不得隐瞒或夸大。陈述事实，但不建议采取补救措施或管理措施，不使用虚构的金额或不受支持的保证语言，并省略账户级标识符。生成一个不超过两页的签名就绪展览，如 `affiliate_transaction_certification_exhibit.docx`，使用该文件名写入工作目录的顶层。准确地给拉格希尔德一个可辩护的认证职位——不合格、合格或不支持——并以该决定而不是后续步骤列表结束。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `affiliate_transaction_certification_exhibit.docx` — 一份两页或更短的、可签名的联属交易合规认证展示，将 2025 与 2024 进行比较，并说明一个可辩护的认证立场。 （将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。；准确使用文件名 affiliate_transaction_certification_exhibit.docx。；不要超过两个渲染页面。；将 31 12 月 2025 与 2024 进行比较。；准确说明一个认证位置：不合格、合格或不支持。；不要提出补救或管理行动。；不要编造金额或包含账户级标识符。；以认证决定结束，而不是后续步骤列表。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
WARDENBY UTILITIES
Affiliate-Transaction Compliance Certification Exhibit
Year ended 31 December 2025 | Comparative year ended 31 December 2024
EXECUTIVE CERTIFICATION BASIS
Recorded affiliate transactions increased $1.9 million (8.2%) to $25.0 million in 2025 from $23.1 million in 2024. This exhibit supports one bounded accounting-compliance determination on affiliate transactions and related allocation, reconciliation, review-evidence, and presentation matters; the volume increase is not itself a compliance conclusion.
Management is responsible for the underlying records, allocation practices, and representations. The basis comprises Wardenby’s cost-allocation manual, department records and logs, management representations, and prior-cycle audit findings. Accounting did not independently validate the Engineering allocation model’s design or operating inputs.

Engineering is the largest contributor to the increase ($0.9 million; 47.4% of the total increase), followed by Shared IT ($0.5 million). Engineering’s increase reflects its peak-demand allocation model. The model owner represented that the model was applied consistently; that representation is not an accounting validation of the model’s design or operating inputs. Because those elements were not validated, accounting cannot conclude on that allocation basis. This limitation is consequential given Engineering’s $7.6 million of 2025 affiliate activity.

The logs offset the stale receivable against the stale payable and therefore show the net receivable. Wardenby’s cost-allocation manual prohibits offsetting; the presentation is inconsistent with that internal requirement. Stale status concerns unresolved balances, whereas offsetting concerns their presentation. The substantially larger 2025 gross stale balances make the current-year netting matter more significant than in 2024; arithmetic netting does not settle, extinguish, or validate either gross balance.
RECONCILIATION AND REVIEW-EVIDENCE CONTEXT
The prior-cycle audit found late quarterly reconciliations and missing review evidence. In 2025, quarterly reconciliations were completed on time, an improvement relative to the prior late-reconciliation finding. The Fleet second-quarter review is undated; this is a remaining, narrower exception in evidence of review timing and does not establish that the review was not performed.
CERTIFICATION DECISION
QUALIFIED CERTIFICATION. For the year ended 31 December 2025, the affiliate-transaction compliance certification is qualified for the prohibited netting of stale affiliate balances and the unvalidated Engineering peak-demand allocation-model design and operating inputs, with the undated Fleet second-quarter review noted as an isolated evidence-of-timing gap. The qualification does not negate the recorded transaction totals or the timely 2025 quarterly reconciliations.

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 可交付成果位于顶层，文件名为 affiliate_transaction_certification_exhibit.docx，并作为有效的 Word 文档打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认准确的区分大小写的文件名、位置、扩展名，并且可以打开该包而无需修复。

original.criterion: The required DOCX deliverable exists at the top level under the exact filename affiliate_transaction_certification_exhibit.docx and opens as a valid Word document.
original.evidence: Submitted file and DOCX package structure.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact case-sensitive filename, location, extension, and that the package can be opened without repair.

criteria.description: 完整呈现的展览内容不超过两页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公引擎进行渲染并计算所有页面，包括大部分空白的溢出页面。

original.criterion: The fully rendered exhibit occupies no more than two pages.
original.grader_hint: Render with a standard office engine and count all pages, including mostly blank overflow pages.

criteria.description: 可以看出，该工件是正式的联属交易合规性认证展示，而不是备忘录、教程、工作文件或程序。
criteria.evidence: 标题、框架、正文、结论和签名演示。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估整个文件；它应该适合包含在监管认证表中。

original.criterion: The artifact is recognizably a formal affiliate-transaction compliance certification exhibit rather than a memo, tutorial, working paper, or procedure.
original.evidence: Title, framing, body, conclusion, and signature presentation.
original.grader_hint: Assess the document as a whole; it should be suitable for inclusion with a regulatory certification form.

criteria.description: 该展览已准备好签名，没有起草注释、占位符、跟踪更改、未解决的评论或可见的编辑说明。
criteria.evidence: 可见的文档内容和 DOCX 修订/评论元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查渲染的页面以及 DOCX 中支持的注释和跟踪修订部分（如果支持）。

original.criterion: The exhibit is signature-ready, with no drafting notes, placeholders, tracked changes, unresolved comments, or visible editing instructions.
original.evidence: Visible document content and DOCX revision/comment metadata.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the rendered pages and, where supported, comments and tracked-revision parts in the DOCX.

criteria.description: 该展览将 Wardenby Utilities 确定为所涉及的实体。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找完整的实体名称，而不仅仅是对该实用程序的通用引用。

original.criterion: The exhibit identifies Wardenby Utilities as the entity covered.
original.grader_hint: Look for the full entity name, not merely a generic reference to the utility.

criteria.description: 该附件将主要报告期确定为截至3112 月2025 的年度。
criteria.evidence: 期间标题、范围声明或认证声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受明确的等效日期格式。

original.criterion: The exhibit identifies the principal reporting period as the year ended 31 December 2025.
original.evidence: Period caption, scope statement, or certification statement.
original.grader_hint: Accept an unambiguous equivalent date format.

criteria.description: 展览将2024标识为比较时期。
criteria.grader_hint: 2024作为比较器的作用一定要清楚。

original.criterion: The exhibit identifies 2024 as the comparative period.
original.grader_hint: The role of 2024 as the comparator must be clear.

criteria.description: 范围仅限于关联交易以及所陈述事实证明的相关分配、对账、审查和列报事项。
criteria.grader_hint: 该证据不应暗示对公用事业公司更广泛的财务报表或整体监管合规性的结论。

original.criterion: The scope is limited to affiliate transactions and the related allocation, reconciliation, review, and presentation matters evidenced by the stated facts.
original.grader_hint: The exhibit should not imply a conclusion on the utility’s broader financial statements or overall regulatory compliance.

criteria.description: 该图表将记录的联属交易金额与未偿联属余额区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 围绕交易和陈旧余额数据的标签和叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者不应将$25.0百万交易量误认为是资产负债表金额或将陈旧余额误认为年度交易量。

original.criterion: The exhibit distinguishes recorded affiliate-transaction amounts from outstanding affiliate balances.
original.evidence: Labels and narrative surrounding the transaction and stale-balance figures.
original.grader_hint: A reader should not mistake the $25.0 million volume for a balance-sheet amount or the stale balances for annual transaction volume.

criteria.description: 该证据充分解释了其依据，表明评估涉及成本分配手册、部门记录、管理层陈述和先前的审计结果，但没有声称这些材料经过独立审计。
criteria.grader_hint: 同等简洁的措辞是可以接受的；检查来源透明度和克制。

original.criterion: The exhibit explains its basis sufficiently to show that the assessment concerns the cost-allocation manual, department records, management representations, and prior audit findings without claiming those materials were independently audited.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent concise wording is acceptable; check both source transparency and restraint.

criteria.description: 基础记录、分配实践和陈述的责任属于 Wardenby 管理层，而不是编制者或委员会审计员。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞不必模仿审计报告，但不得错误分配责任。

original.criterion: Responsibility for the underlying records, allocation practices, and representations is attributed to Wardenby management rather than to the preparer or commission auditor.
original.grader_hint: The wording need not mimic an audit report, but responsibility must not be misassigned.

criteria.description: 该证据并未将工作描述为审计、审查、检查、商定程序业务或其他保证业务。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当文件避免正式约定标签和已获得保证的同等声明时才予以信用。

original.criterion: The exhibit does not characterize the work as an audit, review, examination, agreed-upon procedures engagement, or other assurance engagement.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if the document avoids both formal engagement labels and equivalent claims that assurance was obtained.

criteria.description: 该证据并不声明或暗示所有关联交易都是完整、准确、公平、审慎或无条件合规的。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据有限的事实和未解决的问题评估每项索赔的广度。

original.criterion: The exhibit does not state or imply that all affiliate transactions are complete, accurate, arm’s-length, prudent, or compliant without qualification.
original.grader_hint: Evaluate the breadth of each claim against the limited facts and unresolved matters.

criteria.description: 该手册禁止抵消的规定被描述为 Wardenby 适用的内部要求，而不是通用会计规则或特定司法管辖区的法律授权。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件可以称这种做法不符合手册，但不应发明外部权威。

original.criterion: The manual’s prohibition on offsetting is described as Wardenby’s applicable internal requirement, not as a universal accounting rule or jurisdiction-specific legal mandate.
original.grader_hint: The document may call the practice noncompliant with the manual but should not invent external authority.

criteria.description: 上一周期的审计结果被视为历史背景，而不是自动结转为当年的例外情况。
criteria.grader_hint: 证据应区分先前审计发现的内容与2025事实所确定的内容。

original.criterion: The prior-cycle audit findings are treated as historical context rather than automatically carried forward as current-year exceptions.
original.grader_hint: The exhibit should distinguish what the prior audit found from what the 2025 facts establish.

criteria.description: 该展览报告了 2025 记录的关联交易总额为 $25.0 万。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受$25,000,000或准确标记的等效内容。

original.criterion: The exhibit reports total recorded affiliate transactions of $25.0 million for 2025.
original.grader_hint: Accept $25,000,000 or an accurately labeled equivalent.

criteria.description: 该展览报告了 2024 记录的关联交易总额为 $23.1 万。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受$23,100,000或准确标记的等效内容。

original.criterion: The exhibit reports total recorded affiliate transactions of $23.1 million for 2024.
original.grader_hint: Accept $23,100,000 or an accurately labeled equivalent.

criteria.description: 展览表明或明显支持同比总增长 $1.9 万。
criteria.evidence: 计算出的变化或明显可减去的总数。

original.criterion: The exhibit states or visibly supports a total year-over-year increase of $1.9 million.
original.evidence: Calculated change or clearly subtractable totals.
original.grader_hint: Check 25.0 minus 23.1; tolerance is ±$0.01 million.

criteria.description: 如果说明总变化百分比，则大约为8.2%，并标记为增加。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算1.9除以23.1；公差为±0.1百分点。如果没有说明总百分比，则不予计入。

original.criterion: If the total percentage change is stated, it is approximately 8.2% and is labeled as an increase.
original.grader_hint: Calculate 1.9 divided by 23.1; tolerance is ±0.1 percentage point. If no total percentage is stated, no credit.

criteria.description: 四个2025部门的金额与规定的$25.0百万总数一致。

original.criterion: The four 2025 department amounts reconcile to the stated $25.0 million total.
original.grader_hint: Verify 7.4 + 5.8 + 4.2 + 7.6 = 25.0, allowing only rounding inherent in the displayed units.

criteria.description: 四个2024部门的金额与规定的$23.1百万总数一致。

original.criterion: The four 2024 department amounts reconcile to the stated $23.1 million total.
original.grader_hint: Verify 7.0 + 5.3 + 4.1 + 6.7 = 23.1, allowing only rounding inherent in the displayed units.

criteria.description: 2025 的客户运营量为 $7.4 百万，2024 的客户运营量为 $7.0 百万。
criteria.grader_hint: 期间值及其与客户运营的关联都必须正确。

original.criterion: Customer Operations is shown at $7.4 million for 2025 and $7.0 million for 2024.
original.grader_hint: Both period values and their association with Customer Operations must be correct.

criteria.description: 客户运营部门的美元变动显示或清楚地描述为 $0.4 万的增长。
criteria.grader_hint: 公差为±$0.01百万。

original.criterion: Customer Operations’ dollar movement is shown or clearly described as a $0.4 million increase.
original.grader_hint: Tolerance is ±$0.01 million.

criteria.grader_hint: 期间值及其与共享 IT 的关联都必须正确。

original.criterion: Shared IT is shown at $5.8 million for 2025 and $5.3 million for 2024.
original.grader_hint: Both period values and their association with Shared IT must be correct.

criteria.description: 共享 IT 的美元变动显示或清楚地描述为 $0.5 百万美元的增长。
criteria.grader_hint: 公差为±$0.01百万。

original.criterion: Shared IT’s dollar movement is shown or clearly described as a $0.5 million increase.
original.grader_hint: Tolerance is ±$0.01 million.

criteria.description: 2025 的车队显示为$4.2 百万，2024 的车队显示为$4.1 百万。
criteria.grader_hint: 两个周期值及其与舰队的关联都必须正确。

original.criterion: Fleet is shown at $4.2 million for 2025 and $4.1 million for 2024.
original.grader_hint: Both period values and their association with Fleet must be correct.

criteria.description: Fleet 的美元变动显示或清楚地描述为 $0.1 百万增长。
criteria.grader_hint: 公差为±$0.01百万。

original.criterion: Fleet’s dollar movement is shown or clearly described as a $0.1 million increase.
original.grader_hint: Tolerance is ±$0.01 million.

criteria.description: 2025 的工程量为$7.6 百万，2024 的工程量为$6.7 百万。
criteria.grader_hint: 周期值及其与工程的关联必须正确。

original.criterion: Engineering is shown at $7.6 million for 2025 and $6.7 million for 2024.
original.grader_hint: Both period values and their association with Engineering must be correct.

criteria.description: 工程部门的美元变动被显示或清楚地描述为$0.9百万的增长。
criteria.grader_hint: 公差为±$0.01百万。

original.criterion: Engineering’s dollar movement is shown or clearly described as a $0.9 million increase.
original.grader_hint: Tolerance is ±$0.01 million.

criteria.description: 工程被正确地确定为$1.9百万总增长的最大贡献者。
criteria.grader_hint: 将工程部的$0.9百万增长与其他部门的变动进行比较。

original.criterion: Engineering is correctly identified as the largest departmental contributor to the $1.9 million total increase.
original.grader_hint: Compare Engineering’s $0.9 million increase with the other departmental movements.

criteria.description: 如果量化工程在总增量中所占的份额，大约为47.4%。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算0.9除以1.9；公差为±0.2百分点。如果没有注明份额，则不予信用。

original.criterion: If Engineering’s share of the total increase is quantified, it is approximately 47.4%.
original.grader_hint: Calculate 0.9 divided by 1.9; tolerance is ±0.2 percentage point. If no share is stated, no credit.

criteria.description: 逐年讨论优先考虑工程和共享 IT 运动，而不是给予每个部门同等的叙述权重。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估是否使用有限的空间来解释较大的驱动器，同时表格保留较小的运动。

original.criterion: The year-over-year discussion prioritizes the Engineering and Shared IT movements instead of giving equal narrative weight to every department.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the limited space is used to explain the larger drivers while the table preserves the smaller movements.

criteria.description: 展览避免将 $1.9 百万增长本身作为合规或不合规的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 音量变化应与控制和呈现异常分开分析。

original.criterion: The exhibit avoids presenting the $1.9 million increase itself as evidence of either compliance or noncompliance.
original.grader_hint: Volume change should be analyzed separately from control and presentation exceptions.

criteria.description: 工程的分配基础被确定为峰值需求模型或明确的等效模型。
criteria.grader_hint: 对分配模型的一般参考是不够的。

original.criterion: Engineering’s allocation basis is identified as a peak-demand model or an unambiguous equivalent.
original.grader_hint: A generic reference to an allocation model is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该展览将工程模型一致地应用到模型所有者或管理层的声明中。
criteria.grader_hint: 该陈述不得被改写为会计师独立确定的发现。

original.criterion: The exhibit attributes the statement that the Engineering model was applied consistently to the model owner or management.
original.grader_hint: The representation must not be recast as the accountant’s independently established finding.

criteria.description: 该展览明确指出，会计并未验证工程模型的设计。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找直接的限制，而不仅仅是诸如“明显依赖管理层”之类的模糊措辞。

original.criterion: The exhibit expressly states that accounting did not validate the Engineering model’s design.
original.grader_hint: Look for a direct limitation, not merely vague wording such as 'noted reliance on management.'

criteria.description: 该展览明确指出，会计并未验证工程模型的运营输入。
criteria.grader_hint: 输入必须单独解决或作为设计的明确配对限制。

original.criterion: The exhibit expressly states that accounting did not validate the Engineering model’s operating inputs.
original.grader_hint: Inputs must be addressed separately or as an explicit paired limitation with design.

criteria.description: 工程限制与会计师无法根据分配基础得出结论有关，而不是作为模型错误的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞应保留验证不足和已证明错误之间的区别。

original.criterion: The Engineering limitation is connected to the accountant’s inability to conclude on that allocation basis, rather than being presented as proof that the model is wrong.
original.grader_hint: The wording should preserve the distinction between insufficient validation and demonstrated error.

criteria.description: 该展览并不证明工程模型的技术有效性、因果准确性、公平性或适用性。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当没有任何措辞超出可用的表述和会计工作时才予以信用。

original.criterion: The exhibit does not certify the Engineering model’s technical validity, causal accuracy, fairness, or suitability.

spec.professional_context: Lanternwood Supply is providing senior regulatory-accounting support for Wardenby Utilities’ enterprise affiliate-transaction certification. The exhibit will be signed by the controller and read by a commission auditor assessing whether targeted scrutiny is warranted.
difficulty_sources: Selecting one bounded certification position from evidence that supports neither an unqualified conclusion nor total refusal to certify
Separating management representation about an engineering model from conclusions accounting can support
Replacing misleading net presentation with concise gross disclosure under a two-page limit
Comparing periods and identifying material drivers without treating volume changes as compliance findings
Reconciling executive accessibility with the precision expected by a commission auditor
Revising prior overbroad assurance language while keeping the exhibit signature-ready

mode_and_intended_verdict.decision_logic: An unqualified certification is not defensible because the logs use offsetting prohibited by Wardenby’s manual, accounting did not validate the design or operating inputs of the material Engineering allocation model, and one current-year review lacks dated evidence. A wholly unsupported position is too severe because all department totals are available and internally reconcilable, the Engineering model owner represented consistent application, and 2025 quarterly reconciliations were timely. The gold must therefore make one bounded qualified certification and end on that determination.

required_factual_relationships: 2025 department amounts sum to $25.0 million: $7.4 million Customer Operations, $5.8 million Shared IT, $4.2 million Fleet, and $7.6 million Engineering.
